**CLAIM NOTIFICATION - PORTAL SUBMISSION**

Policy Holder: Meridian Manufacturing Corp
Policy #: GL-4789-2024-001
Date of Loss: 11/15/2024
Time: Approximately 2:45 PM

INCIDENT SUMMARY:
Employee James Patterson sustained severe lacerations to left hand and forearm while operating hydraulic press #4 in Building C. Press safety guard malfunctioned - failed to engage properly when Patterson reached into work area to clear metal shavings. Guard should have automatically lowered but remained in raised position.

INJURIES:
Deep lacerations requiring 47 stitches, potential tendon damage. Patterson transported via ambulance to St. Mary's Hospital. Currently on modified duty pending surgeon evaluation scheduled 11/22/24.

SUBROGATION OPPORTUNITY:
Press manufactured by Titan Industrial Equipment, installed 03/2023 under service contract #TIE-7734. Safety system inspected by Titan technician Mark Rodriguez on 10/28/24 - just 18 days prior to incident. Work order shows "all safety mechanisms functioning properly." Our maintenance logs confirm no alterations made post-inspection.

Patterson has retained attorney David Mills (Mills & Associates). Demand letter received 11/18/24 seeking $275K for medical expenses, lost wages, pain/suffering. Letter specifically mentions "defective equipment" and "inadequate safety protocols."

We have preserved press in current condition and taken photographs. Titan's service records requested. Our insurance carrier should consider immediate investigation of Titan's potential liability given recent inspection and apparent safety system failure.

Additional parties potentially liable: Titan Industrial Equipment (manufacturer), Rodriguez (inspector), Apex Safety Solutions (our contracted safety consultant who approved press placement).

Contact: Sarah Mitchell, Risk Manager - smitchell@meridianmfg.com / 555-0147

**CLAIM NOTIFICATION - PORTAL SUBMISSION**

Policy Number: GL-7749-2024
Date of Loss: 11/15/2024
Time of Loss: Approximately 2:30 PM

INCIDENT SUMMARY:
Customer Patricia Hendricks age 67 slipped and fell on wet floor near produce section of our Riverside location. Employee had just finished mopping but no wet floor signs were placed. Customer sustained fractured left wrist and possible head injury - transported to Memorial Hospital via ambulance.

THIRD PARTY INFORMATION:
Claimant has retained attorney Benjamin Walsh of Walsh & Associates. Received demand letter 12/8/2024 requesting $75,000 for medical expenses, lost wages, and pain/suffering. Attorney cited store negligence and failure to properly warn of hazardous condition.

PROPERTY DAMAGE: None

INJURY DETAILS: 
- Fractured left wrist requiring surgery
- Concussion symptoms
- Ongoing physical therapy
- Medical bills to date: $18,400

WITNESSES:
Store employee Maria Santos (mopper) and customer James Miller both provided statements. Security camera footage available showing incident.

COVERAGE CONCERNS:
This is second slip/fall claim at this location within 18 months. Previous incident settled for $25,000. Reviewing if premises liability exclusions apply given repeat nature. Attorney already questioning our maintenance protocols and employee training records.

RESERVES:
Recommend setting initial reserve at $85,000 given attorney involvement and injury severity. High probability of litigation if settlement negotiations fail.

INVESTIGATION STATUS:
Store manager completed incident report. Need claims adjuster to interview all parties and review security footage before attorney depositions begin. Time sensitive given 30-day discovery deadline mentioned in demand letter.

Contact: Sarah Kim, Risk Manager
Phone: 951-555-0193
Email: skim@riverside-markets.com

**CLAIM SUBMISSION - PORTAL ENTRY**

Policy Number: GL-4429851-02
Date of Loss: 11/14/2024
Time: Approximately 2:45 PM
Location: 1247 Commerce Drive, Building C Loading Dock

Incident involves slip and fall of delivery driver from Midwest Freight Solutions. Driver (male, approx 45 yrs) was making scheduled delivery to our warehouse when he slipped on wet concrete near loading bay #3. Weather was light rain earlier but had stopped. Driver claims our dock was not properly maintained and lacks adequate drainage.

Driver remained conscious but complained of severe back pain and inability to move right leg properly. EMS transported to Regional Medical Center. Initial diagnosis per driver's attorney (Kellerman & Associates - they contacted us yesterday) indicates possible herniated disc L4-L5 and potential nerve damage requiring surgery.

Driver was wearing standard work boots, no safety equipment visible. Our dock manager states area was inspected at 1:30 PM and deemed safe for operations. Loading bay has slight slope for drainage as designed. No recent maintenance issues documented.

Witness: warehouse supervisor Mike Chen present during incident. Security footage available from cameras 7 and 12.

Attorney demand letter received 11/18/2024 claiming $150,000+ in medical expenses and lost wages. They are alleging negligent maintenance and failure to provide adequate warning of hazardous conditions. Driver has retained medical expert and vocational expert per letter.

This is our second incident at this location in 18 months - previous slip and fall settled for $25,000 in March 2023. Same general area but different circumstances.

Requesting immediate coverage confirmation and assignment of defense counsel. Property management company (Hartwell Properties) should be notified as they handle dock maintenance contract.

Current GL coverage: ISO CG 00 01 04/13 with $2M per occurrence limit. No SIR applicable.

Contact: Jennifer Walsh, Risk Manager (555) 847-2901

Subject: URGENT - Property Loss CPP-2847-001 - Attorney Involved

Claims Team,

Submitting FNOL for our insured Meridian Manufacturing LLC under policy CPP-2847-001, effective 1/1/24-1/1/25. Loss occurred 11/15/24 at 2:30 AM at 4425 Industrial Blvd, Nashville TN.

Water damage from sprinkler system malfunction in Building C - approximately 45,000 sq ft warehouse containing finished electronics inventory. Insured reports $2.3M in damaged goods, primarily circuit boards and completed assemblies ready for shipment. Fire suppression contractor on scene confirmed accidental discharge from defective sprinkler head in Zone 7.

COVERAGE CONCERNS: Insured's attorney David Kellerman (Kellerman & Associates) already retained and demanding immediate advance payment under CP 10 30 04 13 form. They're citing the "reasonable expenses" provision and threatening coverage action if we don't respond within 72 hours. Insured claims manufacturing delay will trigger $500K+ BI loss under the CP 00 30 endorsement.

SUBROGATION POTENTIAL: Strong case against Reliable Fire Protection who installed system 8/2023. Their tech was on-site for routine maintenance 11/12/24, three days before loss. Insured preserved failed sprinkler head and has surveillance footage.

Policy includes $50K SIR per occurrence. GL carrier is Travelers under separate policy. Recommend immediate reservation of rights letter given BI exposure and attorney involvement. TPA assignment requested for Apex Claims Solutions if available in Nashville territory.

Insured expects adjuster contact today. They've already hired ServiceMaster for mitigation at $85/hour. Please expedite assignment.

Thanks,
Rick Morrison  
Morrison Risk Advisors
